# netbox_fhrp_group_assignment (Data Source)

Retrieves a single fhrp group assignment from NetBox. The lookup fails if no match or more than one match is found.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_fhrp_group_assignment" "example" {
  id       = 1
  group_id = 1
}

output "fhrp_group_assignment_id" {
  value = data.netbox_fhrp_group_assignment.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `group_id` (Number) The ID of the group associated with the fhrp group assignment.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the fhrp group assignment.
- `interface_type` (String) The interface type of the fhrp group assignment.
- `priority` (Number) The priority of the fhrp group assignment.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) The created of the fhrp group assignment.
- `interface` (String) The interface of the fhrp group assignment.
- `interface_id` (Number) The interface id of the fhrp group assignment.
- `last_updated` (String) The last updated of the fhrp group assignment.
